mentions.name: VCamper
mentions.description: This tool uses a staged LLM pipeline to analyze a Git commit range and flag likely security vulnerability patches before CVE publication, even when they look like routine changes. It is a proof of concept that, on known cases like curl CVE-2025-0725, recovered the published root cause from the patch alone.
mentions.problem: Once a patch for a security vulnerability is public, the patch itself can reveal the vulnerability before the CVE is published, and LLMs could make quietly shipping a fix much harder to keep under the radar.
mentions.source_excerpt: VCamper: use LLMs to spot security fixes before CVE publication
